symptom: A synthetic own enumerable callable toJSON on the research mapping context was invoked by JSON.stringify after canonicalization and could replace the contextDigest input. An ambient Array.prototype.toJSON could likewise rewrite a synthetic nested array during canonical digest construction. Both were reproduced with isolated Node 22.16.0 fixtures; no K archive, private paths, odds, database or production evidence was used.
lesson: Sorting own enumerable fields into a canonical object does not make JSON.stringify immune to callable own toJSON or an inherited array toJSON hook. A digest can be computed over a substituted value even when the original source fields were enumerated. The Forward Vault toJSON learning applies to the separate shadow-evidence builder as a reusable guardrail.
guardrail: Reject callable scalar values during shadow canonicalization before JSON.stringify, and give newly constructed canonical arrays a null prototype so ambient Array.prototype.toJSON cannot rewrite digest bytes. Regress both synthetic hooks with invocation counters, restore ambient prototypes, and preserve baseline digest and valid shadow evidence. This is research-only and never authorizes K data, Current BUY, LINE, public publishing or production.
